headline: LA28 Sponsors Join LABC Institute to Launch Campaign to Help Local Small Businesses Win Contracts for 2028 Olympics and Super Bowl LXI
summary: LOS ANGELES, August 05, 2026--The Los Angeles Business Council Institute (LABCi), joined by LA28 Olympic and Paralympic Games sponsors JPMorgan Chase, AECOM, Cisco, and CDW, announced the expansion of the Compete4LA platform to help local small businesses win contracts for the 2028 Summer Olympics and other major events and projects, including Super Bowl LXI and the Los Angeles Convention Center expansion.
